description: RAG 来源注册表：语料条目由 SourceRegistry 加载。verify_interval_days 按类型分档：政策 90 天、标准 365 天、价格数据 7 天、研究与统计通常 90 天。corroborated_by 只填写同语言、同类型、不同发布机构且能佐证同一主题的 source_id。

sources.title: GB 50797 光伏发电站设计规范
sources.content: 光伏发电站设计规范，涵盖组件布置、间距与电气设计要求。
sources.source_org: 国家市场监督管理总局 国家标准全文公开系统
sources.license_note: 国家标准全文公开系统提供免费在线阅读；引用须标注标准号与年代号。

sources.title: 关于有序推动绿电直连发展有关事项的通知
sources.content: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局发布的绿电直连政策文件，明确项目范围、源荷匹配、并网运行与安全责任。计量与结算流程要点。
sources.license_note: 政府公开发布文件，转载引用须注明来源为国家能源局。

sources.title: 国家能源局：2026 年一季度新型储能发展情况
sources.content: 国家能源局公开的新型储能装机与发展情况答复；截至 2026 年一季度末，全国已建成投运新型储能装机规模超过 1.4 亿千瓦。
sources.license_note: 政府公开发布文件，转载引用须注明来源为国家能源局。

sources.title: 新型能源体系建设“十五五”规划
sources.content: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局发布的 2026—2030 年新型能源体系建设国家级规划，覆盖能源安全、绿色转型、新能源发展与系统调节能力。
sources.source_org: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局
sources.license_note: 政府公开发布文件；摘要为项目原创表述，引用原文须注明发布机构和文件日期。

sources.title: IEC 61724-1 Photovoltaic System Performance Monitoring
sources.content: International standard for PV system performance monitoring, including performance ratio calculation and data quality requirements.
sources.license_note: IEC standards are copyrighted; summaries are original text, full text requires purchase from the IEC Webstore.

sources.title: United States Federal Investment Tax Credit for Solar
sources.content: The federal Investment Tax Credit (ITC) applies to solar photovoltaic and storage projects, with interconnection and placed-in-service requirements.
sources.source_org: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Energy Efficiency and Renewable Energy
sources.license_note: U.S. federal government publication, generally public domain; attribution to energy.gov required.

sources.title: IEEE 1547 Interconnection Standard for Distributed Energy Resources
sources.content: IEEE 1547 defines technical requirements for interconnecting distributed energy resources with the electric power system in the United States.
sources.license_note: IEEE standards are copyrighted; summaries are original text, full text requires purchase via IEEE Xplore.

sources.title: Distributed Solar Grid Interconnection Guide
sources.content: Practical guide to distributed solar interconnection applications, studies, and agreements across major markets.
sources.license_note: NREL publications are U.S. government-funded works; reuse with attribution per NREL copyright notice.

sources.title: 光伏组件与硅料价格周度行情
sources.content: 光伏产业链硅料、硅片、电池片与组件周度价格走势与成交区间。
sources.license_note: 协会公开发布行情信息，引用须注明来源；数据更新频繁，按周核验。

sources.title: EIA Electric Power Monthly Average Electricity Prices
sources.content: Average retail electricity prices and generation fuel costs by sector and state, published monthly by the U.S. Energy Information Administration.
sources.license_note: U.S. government work, public domain; cite EIA as the source when republishing.

sources.title: Renewable Capacity Statistics 2026
sources.content: IRENA's March 2026 publication provides renewable power capacity statistics for 2016–2025, with country and technology tables and a documented statistical scope.
sources.license_note: Use the publisher's citation and terms. This registry stores an original summary, not the report text.

sources.title: Global Energy Review 2026
sources.content: IEA's April 2026 review assesses 2025 global energy demand, electricity supply, technology deployment and energy-related emissions, with an accompanying dataset.
sources.license_note: Licensed CC BY 4.0 by IEA; attribution is required. This registry stores an original summary.
